metadata.description: Rust GPU Compute Development Guide — write GPU-accelerated Rust code with proper patterns and awareness of GPU-specific constraints

plugins.name: rust-gpu-compute
plugins.description: Helps developers write GPU-accelerated Rust code with proper patterns. Covers: branch divergence, memory transfer costs, Rust limitations on GPU (no heap allocation/recursion), memory coalescing, and GPU vs CPU场景选择. Based on VectorWare runtime model and WGSL best practices. Use for: boid simulation, particle systems, data-parallel processing, scientific computing, image processing, ML inference on GPU with Rust.
